### New or strengthened units

2B:

- 2023 China–Vietnam coast-guard encounter near Vanguard Bank; Vietnam Fisheries Surveillance pursued a Chinese coast-guard vessel near offshore energy facilities. Attribution: authority-based. [AMTI](https://amti.csis.org/perilous-prospects-tensions-flare-at-malaysian-vietnamese-oil-and-gas-fields/) — `final_evidence`.
- Vietnam’s July 2023 statement reaffirmed peaceful settlement, diplomatic/legal processes, and UNCLOS while maintaining sovereignty claims. [Vietnamese MOFA](https://mofa.gov.vn/en/tt_baochi/pbnfn/ns230717101342) — `final_evidence`.
- Vietnam expanded Spratly dredging by roughly 330 acres during 2023, showing active territorial consolidation rather than passive restraint. [AMTI](https://amti.csis.org/vietnam-ramps-up-spratly-island-dredging/) — `final_evidence`.
- Vietnam’s formal objections to China’s 2023 map and sovereignty claims remain contrary evidence to any overly broad “non-confrontation” characterization; existing EV-32/35 should be retained and linked.
- December 2023 China–Vietnam diplomacy combined maritime incident-management mechanisms with deeper strategic alignment; existing EV-33 should be retained as hedging evidence.

3B:

- The 2023 U.S. State Department report documents restrictions on religious groups, political speech, land-rights complaints, assembly, association, and LGBTQI protections. Attribution remains institutional/authority-based. [State Department report](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2107615.html) — `final_evidence`.
- USCIRF records 2023 arrests, prosecutions, worship restrictions, forced religious renunciation, and pressure on Montagnard and Hmong Protestants, while also recording releases of religious prisoners. Existing EV-37 should be retained as both adverse and mitigating evidence. [USCIRF](https://www.uscirf.gov/sites/default/files/2024-05/Vietnam.pdf)
- Vietnam officially reported 84 suspects prosecuted after the June 2023 Dak Lak attack. This is a primary record of the security response, not proof of the government’s broader allegations. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://baochinhphu.vn/vu-tan-cong-tai-dak-lak-khoi-to-84-bi-can-102230623161038037.htm) — `final_evidence`.
- UN experts later questioned the fairness and discriminatory effects of the Dak Lak prosecutions. This is post-period contrary evidence about a 2023 event and should be `context`, not target-period outcome proof. [OHCHR summary](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2114790.html)
- Freedom House records limited but real LGBTQ-related institutional openings, including the 2021 openly gay candidate and ongoing legal gaps. [Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/vietnam/freedom-world/2023) — `context`.

4B:

- On 6 March 2023, Trong personally presented the Politburo decision assigning Trương Thị Mai as Permanent Member of the Secretariat. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/truong-thi-mai-becomes-permanent-member-of-party-central-committees-secretariat-111230307095651837.htm) — `final_evidence`.
- On 3 July 2023, Trong chaired the Central Military Commission meeting at which Võ Văn Thưởng’s assignment to its Standing Committee was announced. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/president-vo-van-thuong-joins-central-military-commission-111230703162139625.htm) — `final_evidence`.
- The National Assembly elected Thưởng president with 487 of 488 votes, documenting the formal but noncompetitive transfer mechanism. [VOV](https://english.vov.vn/en/politics/domestic/new-state-president-elected-vows-to-resolutely-defend-national-sovereignty-post1004935.vov) — `final_evidence`.
- Existing EV-45/46 should remain context for institutional conditions, not direct personal evidence.

5B:

- The World Bank reported growth slowing from 8% in 2022 to 3.7% in the first half of 2023 and identified public-investment execution and productivity reforms as constraints. [World Bank](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099408408092319382) — `final_evidence`.
- The World Bank’s March 2023 assessment identified low services productivity, restricted services trade, weak technology adoption, and limited domestic-firm linkages. [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2023/03/13/vietnam-economy-forecast-to-grow-by-6-3-in-2023-world-bank-report-says) — `final_evidence`.
- The GSO reported a 2023 income Gini of 0.374, with higher inequality in rural areas and the northern midlands/highlands. [Vietnam NSO](https://www.nso.gov.vn/tin-tuc-thong-ke/2024/04/thong-cao-bao-chi-ket-qua-khao-sat-muc-song-dan-cu-nam-2023/) — `final_evidence`.
- UNDP’s 19,536-person PAPI survey found modest improvement in perceived local anti-corruption control but continuing poverty, employment, income, and economic anxiety. [UNDP](https://www.undp.org/vietnam/press-releases/2023-papi-shows-progress-citizen-perceptions-local-anti-corruption-efforts-and-e-governance-amid-concerns-transparency-and) — `final_evidence`.
- Vietnam’s official 2023 statistics reported 5.05% growth, 7.1 million VND average annual employee income, social assistance exceeding VND12.3 trillion, and rice support for 1.4 million people. These remain collective government outcomes. [Vietnam NSO](https://www.nso.gov.vn/en/data-and-statistics/2024/02/socio-economic-situation-in-the-fourth-quarter-and-2023/) — `final_evidence`.
- Existing partnership evidence remains attributable to Trong as diplomatic direction, but not as proof of realized economic outcomes.

7B:

- Trong chaired the Central Steering Committee’s anti-corruption meeting in May 2023, which directed acceleration of investigations and trials in ten key cases. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/party-leader-chairs-anti-corruption-meeting-111230510154407503.htm) — `final_evidence`.
- At the November 2023 meeting, official records listed new prosecutions, investigative conclusions, indictments, and trials, with Trong directing continuation of the campaign. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://baochinhphu.vn/tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-chu-tri-cuoc-hop-thuong-truc-bcd-trung-uong-ve-phong-chong-tham-nhung-tieu-cuc-102231122162228811.htm) — `final_evidence`.
- UNDP’s PAPI results provide independent public-perception evidence: modest improvement in corruption-control perceptions alongside declining transparency and persistent economic concerns. Existing EV-55 should be retained. [UNDP](https://www.undp.org/vietnam/press-releases/2023-papi-shows-progress-citizen-perceptions-local-anti-corruption-efforts-and-e-governance-amid-concerns-transparency-and)
- No admissible evidence was found for personal/family enrichment, asset concealment, procurement favoritism, or patronage involving Trong. This remains an unresolved gap, not exculpatory evidence.

8B:

- Resolution 01 required ministries and localities to specify objectives, responsible agencies, timelines, quarterly monitoring, and implementation reports. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/resolution-01-on-key-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2023-socio-economic-development-plan-111230207102705303.htm) — `final_evidence`.
- World Bank reporting identified implementation bottlenecks in public investment and recommended institutional and fiscal reforms. Existing EV-61 should be retained as contrary competence evidence. [World Bank](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099408408092319382)
- CFR describes the September U.S. upgrade and December Xi visit as simultaneous strategic courting of Vietnam, documenting a concrete diplomatic-management challenge. [CFR](https://www.cfr.org/articles/xi-jinping-and-joe-biden-compete-win-over-vietnam-regions-critical-partner) — `context`.
- CSIS confirms that the U.S. partnership was elevated in September 2023 while Vietnam continued to avoid compromising its China relationship or sovereignty claims. [CSIS](https://www.csis.org/analysis/indispensable-upgrade-us-vietnam-comprehensive-strategic-partnership) — `final_evidence`.
- Vietnam’s 2023 military guidance and year-end review should remain official self-assessment evidence only; they document objectives and claimed implementation, not independently verified outcomes.

No scores, holistic effectiveness conclusions, null recommendations, exposure labels, or advice to judges were added.
